claim: The Q1 2026 filing puts PepsiCo's revenue at $19.4 million.
summary: Without retrieval tools and with a knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04 (before Q1 2026 ended), the existence and contents of PepsiCo's Q1 2026 filing cannot be verified. The stated figure of $19.4 million cannot be established and is implausible on prior scale (PepsiCo quarterly revenue is typically ~$18-20 billion, suggesting a likely million vs billion unit error), but no post-cutoff filing value can be confirmed without evidence.

sub_claims.text: PepsiCo has a Q1 2026 filing that reports revenue
sub_claims.stated_text: The Q1 2026 filing puts PepsiCo's revenue
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, before Q1 2026 period ends in March 2026 and its filing; without tools cannot establish existence or contents of this filing.

sub_claims.text: PepsiCo's revenue in that Q1 2026 filing was $19.4 million
sub_claims.note: Without retrieval the exact Q1 2026 revenue figure cannot be established. $19.4 million is three orders of magnitude below PepsiCo's typical quarterly revenue scale (~$18-20 billion), suggesting a likely unit error of million for billion, but the filing value itself cannot be verified from pre-cutoff knowledge alone.
